=== alpha pre-commit
#!/bin/sh
# agent-hub:gate (managed; registry gate: strict)
# No direct commit or merge commit on main/master in the main checkout; merge-branch fast-forwards, which does not run this hook.
b=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD)
case "$b" in main|master) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
[ -n "$MERGE_GATE" ] && exit 0
echo "This project has the merge gate on (gate: strict): no direct commits to $b. Work in your own worktree/branch and finish with agenthub merge-branch." >&2
exit 1
=== alpha settings
{
  "sandbox": {
    "enabled": true,
    "filesystem": {
      "allowWrite": [
        "/rt",
        "/bus"
      ],
      "denyRead": [
        "/other"
      ]
    },
    "network": {
      "allowedDomains": [
        "a.example",
        "b.example",
        "c.example"
      ]
    }
  },
  "permissions": {
    "deny": [
      "Read(/other/**)",
      "Edit(/hub/**)"
    ],
    "allow": [
      "Bash(agenthub send:*)"
    ]
  },
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event session_start || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionEnd": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event session_end || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreCompact": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event pre_compact || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event prompt || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event tool_used || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "mcp__ccd_session__start_session",
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "[ -x ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event ] && ~/agent-hub/bin/hub-event open_session_attempt || true"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "env": {
    "UV_CACHE_DIR": "/cache/uv"
  }
}
